== Book 5 ==

== Biography ==

Button-Bright travels with a group that becomes stranded at the edge of the Deadly Desert, unable to reach the Land of Oz. When the shaggy man asks what to do next, having ruled out going ahead or turning back, Button-Bright answers only "Don't know." Left to occupy himself while the others sit in thought, he takes a stick and digs in the earth. Asked to join in dancing, he declines, saying he doesn't want to dance, and instead sits down wearily upon the soft grass.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — friend. Their bond seems suggested by an episode in which Polly and Dorothy tried to comfort Button-Bright, and by their shared confusion when stranded at the edge of the Deadly Desert, where Button-Bright answered "Don't know" and Dorothy added, just as uncertainly, "I'm sure I don't know, either."

'''[[Polly]]''' — friend. The same episode, in which Polly and Dorothy tried to comfort Button-Bright, suggests a friendly bond — notably after Button-Bright sat down wearily on the grass and declared he did not want to dance.

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — acquaintance. Button-Bright is described as wonderfully attracted by the straw man, which could indicate a friendly acquaintance between them.

'''[[THE shaggy man]]''' — acquaintance. Their exchanges while stranded at the edge of the desert, where the shaggy man addressed the group Button-Bright belonged to in deciding what to do next, suggest an acquaintance between them.

'''[[Jack Pumpkinhead]]''' — friend. A friendly bond is suggested, though no direct exchange between the two appears among the available passages.

== References ==

<references/>

=== Events ===

* Dorothy, the shaggy man, Button-Bright, Toto, and Polychrome are stranded at the edge of the Deadly Desert with no way to reach the Land of Oz.
* At the Truth Pond, Button-Bright's fox head and the shaggy man's donkey head wash away, restoring their original faces.
